text:
'fable-advisor' now uses Opus 5 as orchestrator.

Opus 5 shines on long-horizon agentic tasks, so it works amazingly well as an orchestrator. The coherence across steps is exceptional.

Install 'fable-advisor' and set the model to Opus 5 in Claude Code.

Pro tip: Use 'Medium' https://t.co/GNCYaHbXZI
